question: Does the adjacent historical transposition example supply a genuinely different complete human writing contract for a new manual reading?
access: Live route and composition topic read. No native text, profile, image, new source corpus, encoding experiment, frequency count or root-owned file was accessed or modified. No new RAW card was added to the ample reserve.

source.work: Al-Qalqashandi, Subh al-Asha, volumeIX, printed232,1916Cairo edition
source.mirror_locator: Paragraph beginning ومنهم من يبدل الحرف الأول; immediately before numeric Abjad substitutions.
source.reading_method: Direct previously acquired primary scan plus its searchable online transcription; no OCR or other new source corpus.
source.historical_limit: A printed transmission of the historical text, not an inspected medieval manuscript. No Voynich use, alphabet or meaning inferred.

correction_to_initial_retrieval_note.initial_hypothesis: Swap only the first two letters of each word.
correction_to_initial_retrieval_note.reason: That intuitive reading of the prose does not reproduce the printed example. It is not retained as a historically attested complete algorithm.
correction_to_initial_retrieval_note.original_short_quote: فيكتب محمد أخو علي «حمدم خا عويل»
correction_to_initial_retrieval_note.typographic_limit: The print uses undotted final ya forms; the quotation uses normalized modern ya for the name. Alif/hamza typography is not independently encoded by the abstract base-letter trace. This is not a byte-exact source projection.

actual_hand_trace.concatenated_result: H M D M KH A AYN W Y L
actual_hand_trace.finding: Swapping every consecutive pair in the continuous base-letter stream reproduces all ten displayed letters. The pair W AYN crosses the original boundary between أخو and علي. This is stronger evidence than the initial word-local paraphrase, but one example does not determine every boundary/end/orthographic convention.
actual_hand_trace.inverse_of_letter_sequence: Swap the same consecutive pairs again, starting at the known message start. This returns the ten source base letters in order.
actual_hand_trace.inverse_not_yet_supplied: Original word boundaries, vowel/hamza typography, punctuation and sentence structure are not recovered from the letter permutation alone. The changed printed group lengths show why output spaces cannot simply be copied back as source spaces.

human_use_and_unpaid_costs.purpose: Conceal readable correspondence with a small manual permutation, without a separately invented word-to-meaning dictionary.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.memory: One pending source letter and an agreed message start/pair parity. A pair-preserving line break could be implemented, but this is not specified in the cited passage and is not adopted here.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.open_names: Ordinary new names over the agreed alphabet need no learned whole-word code, but the exact treatment of signs outside that alphabet remains unpaid.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.spaces: A complete message contract must say whether spaces are permuted as source units, transmitted separately, or intentionally omitted. These are substantively different rules; none is silently inferred from the displayed gaps.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.odd_length_and_end: The ten-letter historical example is even. Handling a final unpaired letter, an empty message, punctuation and a split pair at a physical line is not fixed by that example.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.twenty_two_drawings: No mapping of the Arabic alphabet or an extended literal alphabet into22 working drawings has been supplied. No cost-free auxiliary marks or distinction between one and two blanks is assumed.
human_use_and_unpaid_costs.meaning_limit: An exact letter-stream inverse can retain source ambiguity; it is not automatically an inverse of the intended meaningful word sequence.

concrete_pretest_obstruction.consequence: If a proposed completion discards the original spaces before applying this permutation and provides no other segmentation information, these distinct ordinary messages have the same permuted letter stream. Language knowledge alone does not make the intended meaning uniquely recoverable. This is a logical illustration, not a historical quotation or corpus test.
concrete_pretest_obstruction.not_a_total_refutation: A separately declared paid word-boundary channel could remove this ambiguity. That would be a new full construction; none is built or selected in this review.

bounded_predecessor_review.difference: Adjacent letter-pair interchange is not shrinking-column transmission. The old stop does not refute every transposition; no repair to941 is proposed.

bounded_predecessor_review.retained_stop: Exactly-one-character right boundary shift, with paid END, failed its complete predeclared frequency screen.
bounded_predecessor_review.difference: Its source character order is unchanged and its spacing inverse is explicitly paid. It is not the same rule as the displayed paired letter transposition. Do not repurpose its end signal as a free historical convention.

bounded_predecessor_review.basis: Curated card read; specific whole-group three-cell obstruction retained.
bounded_predecessor_review.difference: A generic paid source-space symbol and fixed output-cell grouping have already been proposed. Merely adding such markers is not by itself a new useful writer or an escape from930’s exact failed binding.

bounded_predecessor_review.difference: Whole-word reversal is already included there. Successive local pair interchange is not equivalent to reversing every complete word, but no source outcome or statistical promise follows from this distinction.

bounded_predecessor_review.basis: Previously reviewed scoped entropy theorem;1228followups consulted in this block.
bounded_predecessor_review.retained_stop: One output symbol per source letter with only previous decoded-letter state is closed for the fixed Deot projection.
bounded_predecessor_review.difference: Pair transposition can depend on the next source letter and therefore is not automatically this one-step causal family. This scope distinction is not a selected exception or successful countermodel.

bounded_predecessor_review.retained_stop: Whole-word at-most-two-alias concentration bound excludes every specified mixture of the four frozen old source profiles.
bounded_predecessor_review.scope: Any invented static word-local bijective transposition would preserve all word type frequencies and be included in the one-alias case. The historical continuous-pair example with changing boundaries is not established to be word-local, so this bound must not be transferred to it without the missing framing contract.

duplicate_screen: Bounded ideas search/show/duplicates and relevant followup lookup used. Results did not establish an already executed exact historical pair-transposition contract; this is not a claim of exhaustive novelty. No full registry scan.
selection_decision: No complete different writer is nominated from this block. Keep the concrete source correction and open full-message framing problem, rather than registering a quota variant or silently supplying an alphabet/boundary repair. Existing RAW proposals remain retained; this is not exhaustion of all ideas.
what_remains_unknown: The historical passage gives a small useful letter operation, but the full practical relationship between its package spaces, original word spaces, message parity/end and nonletter signs is unspecified here. A new manual challenge would otherwise mainly demonstrate the already known involution while letting its preparer supply the missing meaning boundaries. That does not yet justify a new reading trial.

See HUMAN_FIXED_GAP_PAIR_SWAP_CONSTRUCTION_20261006.json. It includes all copied source signs, line costs and a complete invented paragraph, but its literal realization fails the already retained qokedy triple for both pair phases.
